notes.title: Update Version 1.8 - Implemented Hint System, Anti-Peeping, & More!
notes.content:
[b]Update Version 1.8[/b]
[list]
[*]Implemented Hint System - You can now access hints through the menu button while in the game.
[*]Anti-Peeping - Players are no longer able to look through the walls.
[*]Improved keypad and keyboard usability
[/list]
Share & follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/originsvr/]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/originsvr]Twitter[/url] for the latest updates on what we'll be working on.

[h1]- From your team @OriginsVR[h1]
